leadText: Let's Go is the opening theme for the Korean dub of Mewtwo Returns. It uses the same footage from the Japanese opening OK!.
plainText:
Let's Go is the opening theme for the Korean dub of Mewtwo Returns. It uses the same footage from the Japanese opening OK!.

==Synopsis==
The Pokémon logo appears on the screen. is seen running. appears running with him. appears with them. is seen running too. and are flying in the sky. The group is seen running in the wild. They are passing across a river. They are playing on grass. Gary Oak appears with his on the screen. are seen dancing, an swings by. Ash, Brock, and Misty are seen at a picnic with their Pokémon. , , , and are with Ash. Flashbacks of Delia Ketchum, Mimey, , , Officer Jenny, Nurse Joy and appear. Mewtwo and Mew are seen. Suicune's silhouette appears. Snubbull and Team Rocket are seen, and Jigglypuff sings. Heracross, Pikachu, Togepi, Ledyba, and Hoothoot appear. Ash is in a stadium looking at an unknown Trainer. Chikorita, Totodile, and Cyndaquil are seen. Ash is with Pikachu, and Pikachu uses Thunderbolt. Ash and his friends are seen with lots of Pokémon.

==Lyrics==
 
! Korean
! English

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Let’s hold hands and head off (Let’s go)
Whatever hardships we come across
If we’re together, there’s no need to worry
Where is a place we've never seen?
Even though we tremble in fear
I believe that we can do this
Everyone stand, everyone stand
Let’s go towards that place (together)
To our new world
Let’s hold hands and head off (Let’s go)
Whatever hardships we come across
If we’re together, there’s no need to worry
Don’t worry
Let’s go, our new world awaits
Even though we don’t know its name yet (Let’s go)
It’ll greet us
Let’s head off to our world now
